sentences.text:
Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Dinesh Kumar Paliwal

On The 6 th Of November, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 42054 of 2024
 Ms. Sanjukta Alias Sanyukta Sarkar
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Ruchir Jain - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Pradeep Dwivedi - Panel Lawyer for respondent No.1/ S
 Order
This petition under Section 528 of BNSS, 2023 has been filed for quashment of charge sheet dated 10.10.2017 which is registered as RCT No.5651/2017 and is pending before JMFC, Jabalpur.
Applicant along with other co-accused is being tried for commission of offence under Section 498A of IPC.
On perusal of the order dated 8.8.2019 passed in M.Cr.C. No.25966/2017, it is apparent that petition filed earlier by Siddharth Sarkar and other co-accused persons has been dismissed on merits.
On the same ground new petition cannot be filed.
Therefore, this petition being not maintainable is dismissed.
